adaptations.authMe: Standalone accounts carry Steam ownership as one boolean flag and profile-link visibility as a boolean, and `steam` is an empty object when no Steam account is linked (override: AuthSteamAccount).
adaptations.leaderboardList: Standalone leaderboard user entries additionally carry the users' lifetime control points `gcl` (override: LeaderboardUser).
adaptations.registerSetUsername: Standalone success bodies are exactly `{ok: 1}` without database-driver write metadata (override: UserDbWriteResponse).
adaptations.userBadgeSet: Standalone success bodies are exactly `{ok: 1}` without database-driver write metadata (override: UserDbWriteResponse).
adaptations.userConsole: The standalone console queue returns exactly `{ok: 1}` without a database-driver insert echo (override: UserConsoleQueuedResponse).
adaptations.userDecorationsInventory: No hosted pixel/decoration economy on a standalone server: the inventory is always an empty list.
adaptations.userDecorationsThemes: No hosted pixel/decoration economy on a standalone server: the theme list is always empty.
adaptations.userEmailSet: Standalone success bodies are exactly `{ok: 1}` without database-driver write metadata (override: UserDbWriteResponse).
adaptations.userMemorySet: Standalone Memory writes return exactly `{ok: 1}` without a database-driver insert echo (override: UserConsoleQueuedResponse).
adaptations.userMessagesIndex: Standalone message documents carry `date` as Unix milliseconds instead of an ISO date-time string (override: UserMessage).
adaptations.userMessagesList: Standalone message documents carry `date` as Unix milliseconds instead of an ISO date-time string (override: UserMessage).
adaptations.userMessagesMarkRead: Standalone success bodies are exactly `{ok: 1}` without internal publish/update results (override: UserMessagesMarkReadResponse).
adaptations.userMoneyHistory: Standalone market money-log entries additionally carry the related order id and counterparty (override: UserMoneyHistoryMarketInfo).
adaptations.userNotifyPrefsSet: Standalone success bodies are exactly `{ok: 1}` without database-driver write metadata (override: UserDbWriteResponse).
adaptations.userOverview: Single world: statistics are returned flat (`rooms`, `stats`, `statsMax`, `totals`, `gametimes`) instead of grouped under `shards`; the official web client accepts this shape by wrapping the body as one pseudo-shard (`t.shards || (t.shards = {shard0: t})`).
adaptations.userRooms: Single world: owned rooms are returned as a flat `rooms` array instead of grouped under `shards`; the official web client maps a response without `shards` to one pseudo-shard (`e.shards || {shard0: e.rooms}`).
adaptations.userSetSteamVisible: Standalone success bodies are exactly `{ok: 1}` without database-driver write metadata (override: UserDbWriteResponse).
adaptations.userWorldStartRoom: Single world: the start room is always a plain room name without a `shard/` prefix (the official web client then falls back to its default shard).

notes.authMe: Returns the private-server projection only (`_id`, `email`, `emailDirty`, `username`, `cpu`, `badge`, `password`, `lastRespawnDate`, `notifyPrefs`, `gcl`, `lastChargeTime`, `blocked`, `customBadge`, `power`, `money`, `steam`, `powerExperimentations`, `powerExperimentationTime`); never `cpuShard`, `cpuShardUpdatedTime`, `resources`, SSO links or legacy fields. `steam` is an empty object when no Steam account is linked. Token may be sent as `X-Token`, `Authorization: Bearer`, or `?token=`; each authenticated call issues a fresh token in the `X-Token` response header (default lifetime 60 s).
notes.authSignin: Primary authentication method of a standalone server. `email` accepts an e-mail address or a username (looked up case-insensitively unless it contains `@`); `recaptcha` and `steamTicket` are ignored. Passwords (8-1024 characters when set) are verified as scrypt hashes in constant time (unknown accounts still hash a dummy); every failure answers HTTP 401 `unauthorized`, and accounts without a configured password cannot sign in. Tokens are 64 lowercase hex characters, valid for `tokenLifetimeMs` (60 s default) and refreshed through the `X-Token` response header of authenticated calls.
notes.authSteamTicket: Verifies the ticket with the Steam Web API `ISteamUserAuth/AuthenticateUserTicket` (app 464350) using the operator-configured Steam Web API key, outside the world lock and with a 10 s timeout; tickets must be 1-8192 hex characters. Without a configured key, or when `useNativeAuth` is truthy, it answers `authentication method is not supported`; any verification failure yields `could not authenticate`. New accounts get 100 CPU, a default code branch and empty Memory.
notes.leaderboardFind: Usernames are matched case-insensitively; unknown users yield `user not found`. `mode` is required (`invalid params` when omitted); other modes return empty results. `list` is ordered newest season first.
notes.leaderboardList: Clamps `limit` to 1-20 (default 10), treats invalid `offset` as 0, defaults `season` to the current UTC month and rejects malformed seasons or a missing `mode` with `invalid params`; other modes return empty results. Listed users also carry `gcl`.
notes.leaderboardSeasons: Lists every month with recorded scores plus the current month.
notes.registerSetUsername: Also rejects the reserved system user name and an e-mail already used by another account (`email already exists`); `recaptcha` and `tutorialDone` are ignored. Returns only `{ok: 1}`.
notes.userBadgeSvg: Renders 128x128 SVG; users without a valid badge get an empty `<svg>`; unknown users get HTTP 404 `text/plain` `Not Found`.
notes.userBranches: Ignores `withCode` and always returns complete branch documents including `user`, `modules` and `timestamp` (Unix milliseconds, absent until code is first saved).
notes.userCloneBranch: Also rejects empty or `$`-prefixed `newName` (`invalid branch name`) and invalid `defaultModules` (`invalid params`). `timestamp` is the cloned branch's timestamp (same Unix-millisecond clock).
notes.userCodeSet: May also answer `invalid params` for malformed requests. Module names `__proto__` are also dropped; `_hash` may be a string or number.
notes.userConsole: Non-string expressions yield `invalid params`. Returns only `{ok: 1}`.
notes.userDecorationsInventory: No hosted decoration economy: always `{ok: 1, list: []}`, and the server advertises no `inventory` feature.
notes.userDecorationsThemes: No hosted decoration economy: always `{ok: 1, list: []}`.
notes.userFind: Answers `user not found` for unknown users or when neither parameter is given, and omits malformed stored badges.
notes.userMemorySet: Rejects invalid paths (empty segments, `__proto__`) with `Incorrect memory path` and, at execution, fails the hidden command when an intermediate path element is not an object. Returns only `{ok: 1}`.
notes.userMemorySegmentGet: Parses `segment` with `parseInt`, so a list reads only its first id and returns a single value.
notes.userMemorySegmentSet: `data` must be a string, number or boolean (`invalid params` otherwise); its string form is stored.
notes.userMessagesIndex: Conversations are keyed by respondent id. Message `date` values are Unix milliseconds.
notes.userMoneyHistory: Numeric log dates are converted to ISO 8601 strings at the wire boundary. Market details also carry `orderId`/`anotherUser`.
notes.userName: Returns the username of the session token owner (standalone session tokens are always full-access).
notes.userOverview: Returns the single-world flat shape (`rooms`, `stats`, `statsMax`, `totals`, `gametimes`) instead of `shards`. `statName` defaults to `energyHarvested`; unknown intervals yield `invalid params` and a missing interval reads as 8 (1440 uses 7 daily slots).
notes.userRespawn: Also deletes the player's power creep records, records `lastRespawnDate`, and resets only the player's controller rooms to `normal`.
notes.userRooms: Returns the single-world flat shape `{ok: 1, rooms}` sorted by controller level (descending) without `reservations`; `reservation` is ignored. An unknown or missing `id` returns an empty list.
notes.userStats: 1440 uses 7 daily slots. `id` is required (the route is unauthenticated, so there is no caller fallback); unknown or missing users yield `user not found`.
notes.userTutorialDone: Accepts the call and stores nothing.
notes.userWorldStartRoom: Ignores `shard` and returns a plain room name: a random owned-controller room, else `W5N5` if it exists, else the alphabetically first `normal` room.
notes.userWorldStatus: Computed from the single world (no objects → `empty`).

AuthSteamAccount.x-profile-reason: The standalone server stores Steam ownership as a single boolean flag and the profile-link visibility as a boolean, and returns an empty object when no Steam account is linked.

ownership.description: Whether the linked Steam account owns the game.

steamProfileLinkHidden.description: Whether the Steam profile link is hidden from other players.

LeaderboardUser.x-profile-reason: The standalone server also includes the listed users' lifetime control points.

UserConsoleQueuedResponse.x-profile-reason: The standalone server returns only `{ok: 1}`; it exposes no database-driver echo.

UserDbWriteResponse.x-profile-reason: The standalone server returns only `{ok: 1}`; it exposes no database-driver metadata.

UserMessage.x-profile-reason: The standalone server serializes message send times as Unix milliseconds.

UserMessagesMarkReadResponse.x-profile-reason: The standalone server returns only `{ok: 1}`; it exposes no internal publish/update results.

UserMoneyHistoryMarketInfo.x-profile-reason: The standalone engine's money-log documents also carry the related order id and counterparty.

UserOverviewFlatResponse.x-profile-reason: A standalone server runs one world, so the overview is returned flat instead of grouped by shard.

ok.description: Success marker; every JSON success body carries `ok: 1`.

rooms.description: Rooms whose controller the user owns, highest level first.

stats.description: Per-room slot values of `statName`, oldest first.

gametimes.description: Highest game tick recorded in each slot, null for empty slots.

UserRoomsFlatResponse.x-profile-reason: A standalone server runs one world, so claimed rooms are returned as a flat list instead of grouped by shard.

ok.description: Success marker; every JSON success body carries `ok: 1`.

rooms.description: Rooms whose controller the user owns, highest controller level first.

UserRoomsFlatResponse.description: Single-world list of claimed rooms (no `shards` grouping).
